author: microscope_agent

observable.name: tracer_diffusivity
observable.definition: Short-time translational diffusion coefficient of dilute tracer spheres, read from the mean squared displacement of tracked centroids, measured at two sample temperatures.

cost.wall_clock: two records back to back plus thermal settling

stop_criteria.statement: abort if the sample temperature moves during a record: the arm would no longer be at one temperature

success_criteria.statement: the ratio between the arms is placed within one decade

open_risks: the two arms share one chamber, so any slow drift in the sample appears as a temperature effect
the exposure is held fixed across arms on purpose; optimising each arm separately would make the comparison meaningless

assumptions.statement: Carried from the brightfield signal axis: the exposure window is set by read noise and blur, and it is held identical across both arms.
assumptions.falsifier: a usable centroid outside the window

assumptions.statement: Two hundred seconds is about ten diffusive times at the expected diffusivity, the same in both arms.
assumptions.falsifier: a converged mean squared displacement from a shorter record

assumptions.statement: Half a kelvin of drift during a record is the largest that keeps the arms separable, given the viscosity moves about two percent per kelvin.
assumptions.falsifier: arm-to-arm scatter larger than the drift effect

assumptions.statement: Carried from the goal: one decade of ratio resolution answers the question.
assumptions.falsifier: a ratio change smaller than the arm-to-arm scatter

assumptions.statement: Fifteen minutes covers two records plus thermal settling between them.
assumptions.falsifier: a measured settling time beyond the estimate
